metadata.derivation: Derived by SpektraLab from kodak_portra_400 (structure only): Ilford Delta 400 Professional technical information sheet: ID-11 stock 8 min 24 C characteristic curve (relative log exposure, anchored at the ISO speed point) and linear spectral sensitivity (wedge spectrogram) Black-and-white profile with three identical channels: characteristic curve and spectral sensitivity digitized from the manufacturer datasheet (base+fog 0.28 removed, log exposure 0 at H = 8.1/ISO with ISO 400); spectrally flat silver density; hanatos2025 adaptation data are the base's.
